## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改后表现

## Validation / 验证

State what was checked, game/framework versions, and tests not run. Compilation alone is not gameplay validation.
说明检查内容、游戏/框架版本及未运行的测试。编译成功不等于实机验证。

## Related changes / 配套修改

Mention balance, bilingual text, assets or persistence changes when applicable.
涉及数值、双语文案、素材或持久化时，说明对应改动。
